Title: Rohan and the Family

Cast

1. Rohan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Isha - 10 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Sonali - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Manoj - 45 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
5. Kunal - 9 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Rohan stands on the road. Sonali and Manoj stand near him.]

Sonali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Rohan sits in the back seat.]

Manoj: "What next?"

[Rohan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Sonali: "Really?"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Rohan in the back.]

Rohan: "What happened?"

Scene 2: The park - Day

Rohan: "Let's begin."

[Rohan does push-ups.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan does yoga on a mat.]

Rohan: "Yes, all right."

[Isha skips rope.]

Sonali (laughing): "Good job, Rohan!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Rohan: "Let's begin."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Rohan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Sonali: "Oh wow!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Sonali (softly): "That's easy."

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[The sun is blazing and Rohan is sweating.]

Rohan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
